gray2006_psd95_exchange.preparation: Dendritic spines in living mouse neocortex
gray2006_psd95_exchange.observable: Green fluorescence from photoactivated PSD-95 divided by the red structural signal in each imaged spine
gray2006_psd95_exchange.scope: The plotted ratios establish local redistribution. Converting them to amounts requires calibrations and coverage of the diffuse pool and other spines. No amplitudes have been digitized.

uchigashima2025_psd95_map.preparation: Reconstructed pyramidal neurons in mouse somatosensory cortex
uchigashima2025_psd95_map.observable: Pre-existing and nascent PSD-95 fluorescence at identified synapses
uchigashima2025_psd95_map.scope: Endpoint maps compare the two labels across synapses of individual neurons. They omit a matched initial and final whole-neuron amount of the old label, including the diffuse pool.
